parameters.query:
INSERT INTO deliveries (tracking_number, customer_id, pickup_location, delivery_location, package_description, package_size, recipient_name, recipient_phone, status, delivery_fee)
VALUES ('SD-' || nextval('tracking_number_seq'), $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, 'CONFIRMED', $8)
RETURNING tracking_number
INSERT INTO escalations (customer_id, reason, priority) VALUES ($1, $2, 'MEDIUM') RETURNING id

const base = $('Process Delivery Request State').item.json;
return [{ json: { ...base } }];

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversations (id, customer_id, current_intent, current_state, context, is_active)
VALUES (COALESCE($1::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), $2, 'DELIVERY_REQUEST', $3, $4::jsonb, $5)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  current_intent = EXCLUDED.current_intent,
  current_state = EXCLUDED.current_state,
  context = EXCLUDED.context,
  is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING id

INSERT INTO messages (customer_id, conversation_id, direction, body, intent, status)
VALUES ($1, $2, 'OUTBOUND', $3, 'DELIVERY_REQUEST', 'PROCESSED')
INSERT INTO audit_logs (event_type, entity_type, entity_id, details) VALUES ($1, 'customer', $2, $3::jsonb)
